market_name.meaning: Reference market name, for example myanmar_market_manual.

avg_xau_usd_price.meaning: Average global XAU/USD gold price for the day.

min_xau_usd_price.meaning: Minimum global XAU/USD gold price observed that day.

max_xau_usd_price.meaning: Maximum global XAU/USD gold price observed that day.

official_usd_mmk_rate.meaning: Official USD/MMK rate used for that day.

unofficial_usd_mmk_buy_rate.meaning: Manual unofficial USD/MMK buy rate used for that day.

unofficial_usd_mmk_sell_rate.meaning: Manual unofficial USD/MMK sell rate used for that day.

unofficial_usd_mmk_mid_rate.meaning: Midpoint of unofficial USD/MMK buy and sell rates for that day.

official_gold_kyat_thar_16k_mmk.meaning: Official Myanmar 16K gold price for 1 kyat-thar used that day.

unofficial_gold_kyat_thar_16k_buy_mmk.meaning: Manual unofficial Myanmar 16K gold buy price for 1 kyat-thar.

unofficial_gold_kyat_thar_16k_sell_mmk.meaning: Manual unofficial Myanmar 16K gold sell price for 1 kyat-thar.

unofficial_gold_kyat_thar_16k_mid_mmk.meaning: Midpoint of unofficial Myanmar 16K gold buy and sell prices.

avg_implied_gold_kyat_thar_16k_official_.meaning: Daily average implied 1 kyat-thar 16K gold price using official USD/MMK.

avg_implied_gold_kyat_thar_16k_unofficia.meaning: Daily average implied 1 kyat-thar 16K gold price using unofficial USD/MMK midpoint.

avg_fx_market_premium_mid_pct.meaning: Daily average percentage gap between unofficial USD/MMK midpoint and official USD/MMK.

avg_gold_official_to_market_mid_premium_.meaning: Daily average percentage gap between unofficial gold midpoint and official gold price.

avg_gold_market_buy_sell_abs_spread_mmk.meaning: Daily average MMK spread between unofficial gold buy and sell prices.

avg_gold_market_buy_sell_abs_spread_pct.meaning: Daily average buy-sell spread percentage for unofficial Myanmar gold.

total_gold_records.meaning: Number of gold API snapshots used in the daily summary.

processed_at.meaning: Timestamp when the daily summary table was generated.
